name: Microsoft Office 2016 (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
summary: Word, Excel and PowerPoint 2016 (32-bit) work through Wine; activate with a product key, not a Microsoft account.
notes:
Office 2016 installed from the 32-bit offline installer (Office Professional Plus / Home & Business ISO, or the 32-bit setup from your Microsoft account page) works through Wine for everyday documents: Word, Excel (incl. macros/VBA), PowerPoint, Publisher and Access open, edit, print and export PDF. Use a product key (KMS/MAK/retail) for activation - 'Sign in' with a Microsoft account, OneDrive sync, Outlook's Exchange/Modern-auth accounts, Skype for Business and the Store are NOT available. Outlook with IMAP/POP works partially. Office 2019/2021 32-bit behave similarly; Microsoft 365 (Click-to-Run online installer) does NOT install - see the office-365 recipe.
Install tips: run the setup.exe from the mounted ISO ('lindos-run --prefix office-2016 /path/to/setup.exe'); when the installer says 'Office 2016 has been installed', close it and start Word from the Start Menu > Wine. Font rendering is best with the Microsoft core fonts (winetricks corefonts is included in this recipe). If a document shows only boxes, run 'lindos-compat recipes apply office-2016' again to reinstall the fonts. The 64-bit Office setup also runs but the 32-bit build is the tested path.
This recipe creates a 32-bit C:\ drive with MSXML 6, RichEdit 2.0 (riched20), core fonts, Windows 7 as reported version and disables the Wine crash dialog.
Native alternatives on Lindos: LibreOffice (pre-installed, opens/saves .docx/.xlsx/.pptx), OnlyOffice Desktop Editors (closest look to Office), office.com in the browser (free with a Microsoft account).
installer_hint: setup.exe from the 32-bit Office 2016 ISO: lindos-run --prefix office-2016 /media/$USER/OFFICE16/setup.exe

alternatives.name: LibreOffice
alternatives.how: already installed on Lindos: Start Menu > Office (Writer, Calc, Impress)

alternatives.name: OnlyOffice Desktop Editors
alternatives.how: native, closest to the Office look: Flatpak org.onlyoffice.desktopeditors or Lindos Settings > Apps > Store
